audit.whatIsWrong: The page states the opposite of what Rebuttal does: content spikes[1].text says 'Mel's R Rebuttal reflects damage but doesn't stop a committed all-in', and whys[4] says 'Point-blank R Guillotine executes her through R Rebuttal's reflect'. It also puts Rebuttal in the wrong slot (it is W, not R) and Solar Snare in the wrong slot (it is E, not W).
audit.why: Riot: Rebuttal 'forms a barrier around herself that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, PREVENTS HER FROM TAKING DAMAGE, and grants her movement speed', on 38/35/33/29/26s. Noxian Guillotine costs 100 mana and 120s at rank 1 — spending it into a barrier that refuses damage is the single most expensive mistake available in this lane, and the page currently instructs the reader to do exactly that. The mirror page (audits/top/mel__darius.json) already states the damage prevention from Mel's side; this page contradicted it.
audit.corrected: spikes[1], whys[4], tldr, winCon, dosFull[0] and phases[4].why now say to bait or wait out Rebuttal and cast Guillotine after the barrier, with the 38s rank-1 cooldown given. Slots corrected to Rebuttal (W) and Solar Snare (E).

audit.whatIsWrong: Both charts read Mel/Skill/Darius/Darius/Mel/Darius/Darius. The prose underneath gives Darius Level 2 ('By level 2 your Hemorrhage pressure already turns the walk-up', 'From level 2 onward... you take over completely') and Level 6 ('Point-blank R Guillotine executes her'), and the packet levelChart is Mel at Level 1 then Darius for all six remaining stages.
audit.why: 58.21% over 2,101 games is one of Darius' best lanes. Mel has no dash anywhere in her kit, so once Apprehend exists at 535 the only stage she can still claim is Level 1, where Radiant Volley reaches 950.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Mel, then Darius x6 — proposed as one atomic group across both layers, with phases[1].why and phases[4].why rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why says Noxian Guillotine 'resets on takedowns'. It does not — it refreshes on the killing blow.
audit.why: Riot: 'If Noxian Guillotine is a killing blow, its cooldown is refreshed for a brief duration.' An assist is not a killing blow, so a Darius who expects a reset from a teammate's finish is left on a 120s ultimate at rank 1. The mirror audit flagged the same family of error from Mel's side (three places there claimed 5 stacks reset R).
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now says it refreshes on the killing blow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Golden Eclipse — Mel's ultimate — appears nowhere on this page. The only 'R' mentioned is Rebuttal, which is her W.
audit.why: Golden Eclipse is 120/100/80s and its range field reads 25000: it 'strikes all enemies marked with Overwhelm REGARDLESS OF THEIR DISTANCE FROM HER, dealing additional damage for each stack'. Combined with Searing Brilliance, which stacks Overwhelm infinitely and executes at enough stacked damage, that means walking out of lane at low health with stacks on you is not safe. Every other line on the page assumes distance ends the exchange.
audit.corrected: content late and phases[6].why now state that Golden Eclipse reaches you at any range once Overwhelm is on you.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Solar Snare as 'matchup-defining' and gives no number for anything, including your own Apprehend.
audit.why: Solar Snare is 11s at rank 1 — it comes back four times per Apprehend and is not the cooldown that decides anything. Rebuttal at 38s at rank 1 is the long one, and it is the one that voids your ultimate. Apprehend is 26s at rank 1 falling to 16s at rank 5.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rebuilt around Rebuttal 38s, Solar Snare 11s, Radiant Volley 10s and Apprehend 26s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer calls Mel 'he/him/his' in tldr, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[0].d, tradeGood and elsewhere, while the content layer correctly uses 'she'.
audit.why: Both layers render on the same page.
audit.corrected: Gender fixed in every string this proposal rewrites.

notes: MIRROR: audits/top/mel__darius.json exists and I reused its findings rather than re-deriving them — Rebuttal 38s at rank 1 and its damage prevention refusing the Guillotine leap, Apprehend 26s/16s, Decimate 9s-5s healing only off champions the outer blade clips, and the correction that Noxian Guillotine refreshes on a KILLING BLOW and not on 5 stacks or on takedowns. Both sides now agree on all of those. Chart alignment: my side follows the packet levelChart (Mel at Level 1, Darius for the other six). The mirror audit reported it could not fix Mel's full-layer chart at all — it says diff, diffRating, carryRating and every phases[].side/.rating on that file are byte-identical boilerplate shared with 18-315 other matchups, so the applier rejected them as ambiguous, and Mel's full layer still scores Mel 7-8/10 in all seven phases of a lane she loses at 58.21%. That is a structural problem on their file, not a disagreement I introduced; mirror-fix.js should not be allowed to resolve toward it. Note that the same ambiguity risk applies to my own chart edits here, since '6/10' and 'Skill' are common tokens — if the applier rejects them, the level chart edits should be held as a group rather than half-applied. Derived-flag misfire, reported not acted on: mel.json flags Rebuttal (W) as 'terrain: creates terrain, blocks paths and dashes', but Riot describes a barrier around herself, not terrain — no path-blocking claim written.
